title: FDA MDR / MAUDE: medical-device adverse-event visibility rail
summary: FDA MDR/MAUDE is promoted as a visibility rail for medical-device harm signals. It can make some suspected device-associated deaths, serious injuries, malfunctions, and adverse events searchable, while explicitly not supplying a complete denominator or causality verdict by itself.

status_history.note: Promoted in rev0011 as source-infrastructure rail for software accountability / attribution-trap records.

claims.claim: FDA says MDR is a postmarket surveillance tool for suspected device-associated deaths, serious injuries, and malfunctions; mandatory and voluntary reporters submit reports, and FDA reviews MDRs received.
what_would_change_status: FDA changes MDR/MAUDE descriptions or reporting rules materially.

evidence_migration.note: rev0016 removes overloaded source_support.source_id/record_id keys and uses typed evidence_refs with ref_kind and support_role.

claims.claim: FDA warns that MDR/MAUDE reports do not by themselves establish device causality, event rates, trend rates, or comparative rates, and the system is limited by under-reporting, inaccuracies, lack of verification, and lack of denominator/use-frequency information.
what_would_change_status: FDA revises MAUDE/MDR limitation language or a specific audited denominator surface is added.

evidence_migration.note: rev0016 removes overloaded source_support.source_id/record_id keys and uses typed evidence_refs with ref_kind and support_role.

evidence_profile.source_depth: one-pass official/institutional source extraction; no coverage or outcome audit
limitations: Establishes infrastructure existence, declared function, and explicit limitations only.
Does not claim completeness, causality, prevention effectiveness, or universal coverage.

type_payload.jurisdiction_or_scope: FDA medical-device postmarket surveillance / public MAUDE interface
signal_capture_model: voluntary reports from clinicians, patients, caregivers, consumers
MAUDE public search and MDR data files
FDA review of reports in context
reporter_protection_design: FOIA redaction for confidential/personal information in public database
type_payload.query_value: Adds a medical-device visibility rail adjacent to Therac-25 without claiming MAUDE can retrospectively reconstruct Therac or assign causality alone.

handling_notes: Keep personal, patient, claimant, and confidential business information out unless directly required and public-source justified.
Infrastructure records are visibility rails, not verdict engines.

unknowns: No audit of MAUDE completeness, timeliness, or software-device coding quality.
Database changed/migrated over time; exact access state needs archive/API pass.
